item.title: South Korean Catholics celebrate 1500th Mass for unity
item.description: Catholics in South Korea’s Seoul Archdiocese joined the 1500th weekly Mass for reconciliation and unity in the Korean Peninsula, which has been celebrated since 1995. Source: UCA News.

item.title: Ukrainian Catholic Church leader thanks Pope
item.description: The head of the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church met with Pope Leo XIV, briefing the Pope on the situation in Ukraine as Russia’s full-scale invasion reaches the four-year mark. Source: OSV News.

item.title: Archbishop calls for united effort to tackle Fiji’s drug problem
item.description: Suva Archbishop Peter Loy Chong has called for a united response from Fiji’s Christian, Hindu and Muslim communities to tackle the country’s growing drug problem. Source: CathNews NZ.

item.title: ACU joins drive to deliver 4000 more personal care workers to regional communities
item.description: Australian Catholic University is helping to deliver 4000 additional personal care workers in regional, rural and remote communities across Australia in the next three years.

item.title: Mass to mark 30th anniversary of cathedral fire
item.description: Thirty years ago, a devastating fire tore through St Patrick’s Cathedral in Parramatta – a moment seared into the memory of parishioners, clergy, and school communities of the Parramatta Diocese. Source: Catholic Outlook.

item.title: ‘Unite Against Poverty’: Caritas launches Project Compassion 2026
item.description: Caritas Australia’s annual Lenten fundraising and awareness appeal, Project Compassion, begins tomorrow with the theme, “Unite Against Poverty”.

item.title: Albany church to become Bunbury’s first diocesan shrine
item.description: St Joseph’s Church in Albany, Western Australia, will next month become Bunbury Diocese’s first diocesan shrine.

item.title: Commissioner says Australia needs tougher anti-slavery laws
item.description: Australia’s anti-slavery commissioner has called for tough new laws forcing Australian companies to take slavery in their supply chains seriously. Source: ABC News.

item.title: Health care not luxury but a human right: Pope
item.description: Pope Leo XIV yesterday warned that modern conflicts and widening social disparities are eroding respect for human life and equal access to health care. Source: EWTN News.
